name: Special Disability Allowance
description: A financial allowance paid to a benefit or pension recipient whose partner is hospitalised and receiving a reduced benefit rate, to help cover extra costs associated with their partner's hospitalisation.

attributes.summary: Financial allowance paid to a benefit or pension recipient whose partner is hospitalised and receiving a reduced benefit rate, to help cover extra costs associated with their partner's hospitalisation.
attributes.eligibility: Client is not in hospital or residential care; Client is getting a main benefit or pension; Client's partner is a patient in hospital or residential care; Client's partner is getting a reduced rate of benefit or pension due to hospitalisation. Exclusion: Veteran's Pension clients in hospital for more than 13 weeks are not eligible as payments are not reduced to hospital rate.
attributes.payment_details: Granted from the date the partner starts getting a hospital rate of benefit, or becomes financially eligible for Residential Care Subsidy. Cessation: stopped from first available date if person receiving it is admitted to hospital or residential care; if client in hospital dies, stopped from the day after death (if in current pay-period), or first available date if advice received within 14 days, or day after date of death if advice received more than 14 days after death; if partner in community dies, continues as part of terminal benefit for 4 weeks. Terminal benefit applies to partner in community getting New Zealand Superannuation in their own right, Emergency Benefit paid at the Supported Living Payment rate, or as a partner getting a joint (apportioned) benefit.
